items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, we got a Philippine bass player... And we had a Philippine boy that played bass.

ctx.x: liquor told him that he was the boss in there, and he could do anything he wanted to do, and he told Skeeter to shut up, and Skeeter wouldn't, because Skeeter had been drinking too. And they had been hangin'-out buddies and been getting drunk every day together and everything. So all of a sudden, Oscar turned around and decided he wanted to stop... I think he was showin' off for the people that was in the plane, that he was Oscar Pettiford. So he slapped Skeeter. And Skeeter jumped up and hit him right in the…
I remember reading you got a Philippine bass player.

Yeah, we got a Philippine bass player. They sent a guitar player on down to the rest of the band. They sent Oscar back to Honolulu to send him over to New York. And we had a Philippine boy that played bass. He couldn't play that good, but we needed a bass anyway.
